__doc__: Single source of truth for the generic sensor telemetry frame format
deployment uses is declared once here, then BOTH sides are generated from
it so the MCU writer and the MPU parser can't independently drift the way
Edit this file, then run:  python3 python/tools/gen_telemetry_schema.py
python/common/telemetry_schema.py (MPU parser). Do not hand-edit either
This is Phase A (experimentation) -- add/remove channels or change bins
freely; the MPU parser needs zero code changes (it loops over sections and
dispatches on data_kind). The MCU side becomes a config toggle over which
section-writer calls run. Both `id` values are opaque numeric identity on
the wire; the semantic meaning ('mic' vs 'accel') lives ONLY here.
channel `name` MUST equal the SensorChannel enum value in
python/registry/registry.py for any channel that feeds the model, so a
decoded section lands in SensorFrame.bins under the key downstream
